author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (ribbon bow with two loops and a knot over two large flared bells) with the rejected drawing (a bare chevron over two tiny 12-unit bells) at 48px in both themes. Redrew the bow as a figure-eight of two ellipses meeting at the knot and the bells as r6 domes with flared skirts, flat lips and hanging clappers, mirrored about x=24. Native review: bow and bells read clearly; loops keep 10 from the bell domes.
omissions: ribbon tails and the round clapper balls
construction_reference: no direct Lucide match; Lucide bell dome-and-lip construction
